summary: This September 2024 religious-imagination lecture is already-public Civilization As Inner Order and Taboo support for animist interconnection, ritual balance, and religion protecting harmony before the wealth-power-war rupture, while adding held seed pressure around shared belief making an imagined world more real than visible matter.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Myth turns taboo into law by placing the rule inside the structure of reality itself.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public episode read already links this mark to the Taboo anchor. The active mechanism is not generic creation myth; it is a sacred boundary becoming enforceable because it is embedded in the world story.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Animals, plants, and humans are all interconnected, and a later religion of wealth, power, and war breaks that order.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public episode read already links the interconnection and wealth-power-war marks to the Civilization anchor. The source's public spine is the contrast between a caretaking inner order and a rival order that worships domination.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the animist/Pygmy interconnection baseline where spirit world, forest, animals, plants, humans, caretaking, harmony, equality, art, and anti-war consequences form a civilizational inner order before the Yamnaya wealth-power-war rupture.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Civilization As Inner Order owns the source when the mechanism is a whole human arrangement: religion, ritual, forest, animal life, social equality, art, and non-war belonging to one world. Do not split it into Animism, Pygmy Religion, Religious Imagination, Forest Religion, or Lost Human Baseline from this lecture alone.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep the ritual balance layer as Taboo's earliest primitive, where killing, eating, hunting, worshipping, obeying, and remembering occur inside an order that can be maintained or violated. Future replacement/compression could add the sleeping-through-the-Malimo passage only if Taboo needs a sharper nonparticipation-as-violence example.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns the source only when sacred participation and prohibition maintain the world's boundary. Civilization owns the broader peaceful inner order; Stories owns narrative world-making only when language or story form is primary; Power owns later abstraction becoming command.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as comparison pressure only: the shaman as engineer, Malimo trumpet, singing to wake the forest, and ritual communication with the spirit world resemble sacred-machine interfaces, but this source's strongest public function is civilizational inner order rather than a distinct material machine.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Sacred Machines should receive this source only if the future question is a concrete ritual interface that bridges invisible order into public practice. It should not become a generic home for all spirit-world claims.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only in future comparison if Stories needs a pre-literate shared-world layer: creation myth explains origin, law, taboo, grandness, completeness, and unity, while collective imagining can make a world feel more true than visible reality.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Stories owns narrative and language as world-making. Civilization owns religion as an entire social ontology; Taboo owns the prohibited boundary; Poetry owns later literary language and form.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep as origin contrast only: shared imagination making a world more real helps explain why later abstractions can become powerful, but this lecture does not itself center money, state command, capital, or artificial scarcity.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Power As Alchemy should not absorb this source unless the active mechanism is conversion from shared imagined order into command, money, scarcity, or institutional power.

new_lens_seeds.title: Religious Imagination As Shared Reality
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A community can make an imagined sacred world more real than visible matter when collective belief, ritual participation, mythic law, and punishment for nonparticipation protect the shared world from private disbelief.
new_lens_seeds.reuse_potential: This seed can later compare animist religion, cave religion, myth-as-law, public ritual, AI-as-god, eschatology, and secular replacement religions, but current public homes already carry the main pressure and a standalone page would duplicate Civilization, Taboo, Stories, Power, and Eschatology.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold this as a routing seed, not a public concept. It becomes public only if later sources prove a narrow mechanism beyond existing homes: the enforcement of shared reality itself, rather than civilization as inner order, taboo boundary, story world-making, or power abstraction.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2024-09-05, this lecture supplies the public page's early animist/Pygmy layer between the 2024-09-03 cave-painting collective-consciousness formulation and the 2024-09-10 Old Europe / 2024-09-12 Yamnaya sequence: religion protects interconnection before religion is rearranged around wealth, power, and war.

The source predates later taboo lectures and gives the primitive non-transgressive form: taboo and ritual maintain balance before taboo becomes a river, shared transgression, sin technology, sacred-game hack, or scapegoat mechanism in later sources.

This lecture is an early classroom formulation of Jiang's later recurring claim that humans are not naturally materialist: modern dismissal of invisible reality is historically unusual, and shared imagination can organize action as forcefully as visible matter.

next_actions.action: No immediate public prose mutation is needed: Civilization As Inner Order and Taboo already cite this source, and the episode read already links exact marks to lens-point:taboo-control-surface-boundary and lens-point:civilization-inner-order-can-protect-or-dominate.

Do not create standalone The World More Real Than Reality, Religious Imagination, Animism, Shamanism, Pygmy Religion, Malimo, Forest Religion, Spirit World, Shadow Dimension, Lost Human Baseline, Collective Reality, or Religious Imagination As Shared Reality pages from this source alone.

If downstream synthesis follows, compare this held seed against the existing Civilization religion-makes-society anchor, Taboo's nonparticipation boundary, Stories' collective-reality language mechanism, Power's abstraction-to-command mechanism, and AI Control / Eschatology religious-imagination pressure before promoting any public page.

If provenance maintenance follows, consider a concept-scoped batch only if exact episode marks need existing anchors; avoid broad links to Religion, Animism, Spirit World, or Stories that blur Civilization, Taboo, Sacred Machines, Stories, and Power boundaries.
